title: Quick Tips
longPress: Long press on a photo for more options
quickActions: Use Quick Actions bar for faster access to features
searchFaces: Search for faces to find photos of people
shareQR: Share albums with QR codes for easy access
createCollage: Create beautiful collages directly from Home screen
favoriteSync: Favorite photos sync across all your devices
albumOrganize: Organize photos into albums for better management
pinchZoom: Pinch to zoom on photos for closer view
swipeNavigation: Swipe between photos in full screen
autoBackup: Photos are automatically backed up to the cloud
